facts.fact: Wastes 行军对话：路线取舍哲学（匀速 vs 速度/战马非工具）——他的回答「你不是被塞进超出能力职责的弱女子——你是为这个世界被锻造出来的」；「The world molded around you, more like it. You are captivating」
facts.anchor: It’s like you were forged for this world.

facts.fact: 互相承诺：他「I'd want you even if you were not Marked back」——她答「I want to keep you」（把心放进他手里）；身体调情「earn my body」vs「I always come out on top」；蓝眼承诺（「若不是你真实的眼睛，别想靠近看我的身体——我说到做到」）
她的一串颂词：「你温和/聪明/Darvic 口音/身材/气场——蠢货，谁都会注意到你」+「for fuck's sake, you're insufferably handsome」；判词「你值得被如实看见，我也配看见我的 Marked」——全场沉默中他让蓝眼 settle
facts.anchor: Your eyes are beautiful, but they are hardly the reason you stand out.

facts.fact: 沼泽扎营：Shadow Vision 领夜行绳阵（「like we did in Skrendith」）；Blight 的蝙蝠玩笑+Draven 的不满（Hellbore 会错意）；Areneas 手语「Fools」；Draven 耳语「我担心的不是你的能力——是我想堵住那小的嘴」+「I don't like him joking about what is mine」
facts.anchor: But I’d sure like to gag the little one.

facts.fact: 夜绳阵：Seafarer 亲自接线打结（Icarus 旁学）——「Maybe it was unfair for you to be our liability after all」（Blight 承认）——「He's not wrong」；「Guess there are no secrets between us. In truth, I'd have it no other way」（全队目击调情）
facts.anchor: Ropes and knots are my thing.
